title: Standing and balance
about: Standing poses for legs, hips and balance, finishing on the floor. A block helps for half moon.

steps.name: Mountain pose
steps.cue: Stand tall, feet together or hip width, weight even across both feet. Lift the chest, relax the shoulders, breathe slowly.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Chair pose
steps.cue: Bend your knees and sit back as if into a chair, arms reaching up. Keep your weight in your heels and your chest lifted.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Triangle pose
steps.cue: Feet wide, front toes pointing forward. Reach over the front leg, lower that hand to your shin and stretch the other arm to the ceiling.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Extended side angle
steps.cue: Feet wide, bend the front knee over the ankle. Rest your forearm on the thigh or hand by the foot and reach the top arm over your ear.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Half moon
steps.cue: From a bent front knee, put your hand down ahead of the foot and lift the back leg to hip height. Use a block or chair under the hand if needed.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Tree pose
steps.cue: Stand on one leg and place the other foot on the calf or inner thigh, never on the knee. Hands together at the chest or overhead.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Plank
steps.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your legs and do not let the hips sag.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Cobra
steps.cue: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Lift your chest using your back, elbows close, shoulders away from your ears.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Hero pose
steps.cue: Kneel and sit back between or on your heels, spine tall, hands on thighs. Sit on a block or cushion if your knees complain.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

title: Seated and floor
about: Seated poses and twists, then back bends, ending with the legs up. Skip or ease any pose that pinches.

steps.name: Hero pose
steps.cue: Kneel and sit back between or on your heels, spine tall, hands on thighs. Sit on a block or cushion if your knees complain.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Cow face pose
steps.cue: Sit with one knee stacked over the other. Reach one arm up and one behind your back and clasp hands, or hold a strap between them.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Head to knee fold
steps.cue: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot against the inner thigh. Fold forward over the straight leg with a long back.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Seated twist
steps.cue: Sit tall, cross one foot over the other knee. Turn toward the raised knee, using your arm against it to deepen the turn gently.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Boat pose
steps.cue: Balance on your sit bones, chest lifted, legs raised. Keep the knees bent if straight legs make your back round.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Locust
steps.cue: Lie face down, arms by your sides. Lift chest, arms and legs off the floor together and look just ahead of you.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Bow pose
steps.cue: Face down, bend your knees and hold your ankles. Kick the feet back into your hands to lift the chest and thighs.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Camel
steps.cue: Kneel upright, hands on your lower back. Lift the chest and lean back; reach for your heels only if it is comfortable.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Fish pose
steps.cue: Lie on your back, forearms on the floor, and lift your chest so the crown of your head rests lightly down. Keep the weight on your arms.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

steps.name: Supported legs up
steps.cue: Lie on your back, lift your legs and hips, and hold your hips with your hands, elbows on the floor. For an easier version, keep hips down and rest your legs up a wall.
steps.credit: Kennguru, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
